visual_logic.color_palette: Dark slate-blue with a creamy-yellow underbelly and a subtle 'frill' of dark clay scales along the spine.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Massive, powerful jaw with a prominent 'pterygoid' tooth row visible in the throat.
visual_logic.pattern_strategy: Deep sea-green with 'cracked' vertical white stripes across the flank.
visual_logic.texture: Small, overlapping diamond-shaped clay scales; glossy black eyes.
visual_logic.environment: Vibrant blue water with long, horizontal underwater sunbeams cutting across the frame to establish a clear tracking line.
visual_logic.pose: A full-body horizontal profile view stretching completely from the left edge to the right edge of the frame. The massive 15-to-17-meter body is aligned perfectly flat in the upper half of the image, keeping the bottom half clear so a second species can easily be drawn or stacked directly beneath it for side-by-side length comparison. Rather than breaching vertically, it cruises horizontally just beneath the surface, its long paddle-like flippers aligned flat along its side, and its powerful eel-like tail extending straight out to the side edge.
